full_details: Hamnet had the morning off on your father's word. He walked the first stretch backward, reciting Latin nouns, and Susanna named the shop-signs that were new. On Chapel Street the black studs stood beside new oak and wet limewash. A carpenter on the wall-plate said fire makes work. Anne came from the baker's with a leather fire-bucket nobody had meant to buy, and said it makes debt. The twins disputed the handle. You stopped the speech and carried the bucket. You came home by the Guild Chapel and did not look at a house. The sword had crossed the lane. It went back on the nail.
one_sentence: You carried the new bucket yourself after Susanna stopped the speech.
title: Fire makes work, and the bucket makes debt
